description:
v1.0 | 112 gates | 3 ticks
https://github.com/byggmesterPRO/pareto-circuits

Multiplies two 4-bit numbers.

Use this circuit wherever a creation has to multiply two whole numbers, for example inside a calculator or in the arithmetic part of a computer.

It multiplies two unsigned binary numbers, a and b, which have the same size. The product is twice as wide as either input. Inputs and output are read least significant digit first.

Inputs (yellow gates, first row, lowest bit first): a = x 0-3, b = x 4-7.
Outputs (green gates): product = x 0-7.

Profile: fast, the build with the fewest ticks for this size.
How it works: Every output is one XOR gate over AND gates of plain inputs: 3 ticks.
Checked on every possible input in a simulator. Gates include the input gates; ticks count the input gate too.
By: byggmesterPRO
